senses.gloss: , Midr. Sam. s. 5 <he>א׳ משלו היה</he> read <he>הפְּרוּטוֹת … היו</he> (v. <cite ref="Q01667"><he>פְּרוּטָה</he></cite>, esp.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 50b">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite>) he (Nebucadnezar) had to pay the writer’s fees (for the change of <he>בר אלהין</he> into <he>מלאכיה</he> <cite ref="Daniel 3:25">Dan. III, 25</cite>; <cite ref="Daniel 3:28">28</cite>), i.e. had to suffer for it; v. <cite ref="A01332"><he>אִימּוּס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:9:1">Cant. R. to VII, 9</cite> <he>פריטין משלו היו</he> read <he>פרוטין</he>.
